games.name: Typical Colors 2
games.desc:
Dive into intense battles with over 200 unique weapons at your disposal!
Play as an offensive, defensive, or support role to push your team to victory.
This game is heavily inspired by Team Fortress 2.

Mobile Players: iOS devices are known to run much better than Android, if you have an android phone, make sure you have at least 6+ gb of Ram.

NOTICE: If you're noticing any frame drops, reduce your graphics quality and mess around with the game's settings [Main Menu > Settings (Top Right) > Graphics] (The game disables some visual features for better frames).

Basic Keyboard and Mouse Bindings:
M  -  Main Menu
W  -  Walk Forward
S  -  Walk Backward
A  -  Walk Left
D  -  Walk Right
Space  -  Jump
Ctrl  -  Crouch
Q  -  Previous Weapon
E  - Call for Doctor
Tab - Show Scoreboard
Numbers keys 1,2,3,4,5 - Select weapon
Scroll Wheel - Select weapons
Left Mouse Button  -  Primary Fire
Right Mouse Button -  Secondary Fire
Y or / - Open All chat
U - Open Team Chat
